text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Yasuda Kinen. Daiichi Ruby 
was concerned by the crowd's declining 
interest. Resolving to bring even greater 
excitement, she declared war upon her 
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby carries an air different from 
her usual self. She says that her duty to 
win for the family is transforming into a 
personal desire to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer pushes her forward, saying her 
speed makes victory possible. Following 
her proud bloodline, Daiichi Ruby aims for 
a dazzling victory—!
